# Argenta

> A Python library for building modular CLI applications with interactive REPL-like sessions, declarative command handlers, native DI via dishka, and automatic flag parsing/validation.

Argenta creates applications that run a cyclic interactive session (like a Python REPL or MySQL console): the app starts once, and the user executes commands one after another without restarting. Commands and their handlers are registered via decorators; flags are parsed, validated and passed to handlers through a typed `Response` object. Requires Python 3.12+.

## Guides

- [Quick Start](https://argenta.wiki/root/quickstart.html): minimal app, calculator with flags, task manager with DI
- [Error Handling](https://argenta.wiki/root/error_handling.html): custom handlers for unknown commands, empty input, repeated flags and invalid syntax
- [Flags](https://argenta.wiki/root/flags.html): defining flags, prefixes, allowed values and validation
- [Overriding Formatting](https://argenta.wiki/root/overriding_formatting.html): plain vs rich rendering of system messages

## Advanced

- [Redirecting stdout](https://argenta.wiki/root/redirect_stdout.html): how handler output is captured and framed, and when to disable it
- [Dependency Injection](https://argenta.wiki/root/dependency_injection.html): dishka integration, injecting dependencies into handlers
- [Argenta CLI](https://argenta.wiki/root/cli.html): scaffolding and running projects with the bundled CLI
- [Testing](https://argenta.wiki/root/testing.html): testing applications built on Argenta

## API Reference

- [API index](https://argenta.wiki/root/api/index.html): all public API sections
- [Router](https://argenta.wiki/root/api/router.html): command registration and dispatch
- [Response](https://argenta.wiki/root/api/response.html): the object passed to handlers
- [Command & Flags](https://argenta.wiki/root/api/command/index.html): Command, Flag, InputFlag, PossibleValues, ValidationStatus
- [Orchestrator & ArgParser](https://argenta.wiki/root/api/orchestrator/index.html): startup-time CLI arguments and app orchestration
- [App](https://argenta.wiki/root/api/app/index.html): application configuration, autocompleter, dividing lines
- [DataBridge](https://argenta.wiki/root/api/bridge.html): shared storage between handlers
